title: Sodium–glucose coupling in cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: A sodium-by-glucose product did not meet the registered incremental prediction criterion for concurrent log-hsCRP: source whole-PSU CV MSE gain -0.000497; frozen-source NHANES2017–2018 gain -0.000617 squared log units (500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.004508,0.001964]). Retrospective cross-cycle evaluation,not untouched or non-NHANES validation. Source n=4225,target n=3954;target weighted baseline/augmented MSE 0.716790/0.717407. No causal mechanism or clinical utility is established. AI-authored public-data computation.
